text:
anais: quick Q — we have a contractor (end date 4/3) with ~32 hours unused PTO. can we either payout or convert to a floating holiday for their last week?

julia (People Ops): contractors normally don’t get carryover. payroll only pays out unused time if the contract/offer letter specifies it. do we have that clause? :thinking_face:

anais: checking the contractor agreement now — no explicit payout clause, just accrual schedule. manager asked if we could make an exception because of office closure week.

julia (People Ops): ok — we can do a one-off swap to a floating holiday credit (internal acct) if manager signs off and we document the exception. need People Ops + Finance approval.

samir (Finance): FYI payroll cutoff for final settlement is 4/5 for that contractor. if we authorize payout we need the variance ticket by EOD 4/1 to hit the cycle. payouts will be processed as misc compensation and taxed accordingly.

laila (their manager): I can approve the swap to floating holiday — prefer that over cash. will submit ticket. is any additional paperwork needed for the contractor?

julia (People Ops): please have the contractor sign the "departure acknowledgement" with the swap note. attach to the ticket. i’ll draft the variance request. link to policy: https://redwood.example.com/handbook/pto#contractors 

people-ops-bot: Reminder — submit the variance via https://help.redwood.com/forms/people-ops-variance. Template: Reason + Manager sign-off + Payroll code.

anais: thx. i’ll get the contractor to sign and will upload the doc.

julia (People Ops): great — when you upload, include this in the ticket body: ``payroll_code: CONTRACT_SWAP`` and "hours: 32". tagging @samir to approve cost center.

samir (Finance): approved if manager confirms. charge to cost center 401-ENG. please note tax handling in the ticket.

anais: uploaded signed ack and submitted variance ticket #VAR-7241. manager approval attached.

julia (People Ops): received. i’ll process the swap with payroll and update here once complete. expect final processing on 4/4. :white_check_mark:

laila: thanks everyone, appreciate the quick turnaround.

people-ops-bot: Ticket #VAR-7241 status: submitted -> awaiting Finance approval.
